name: Piplup
description: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

moves.name: Pound
moves.description: The foe is physically pounded with a long tail or a foreleg, etc.

moves.name: Growl
moves.description: The user growls in an endearing way, making the foe less wary. The target’s Attack stat is lowered.

moves.name: Bubble
moves.description: A spray of countless bubbles is jetted at the foe. It may also lower the target’s Speed stat.

moves.name: Water Sport
moves.description: The user soaks itself with water. The move weakens Fire-type moves while the user is in the battle.

moves.name: Peck
moves.description: The foe is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn.

moves.name: Bide
moves.description: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back to cause double the damage taken.

moves.name: Bubble Beam
moves.description: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the foe. It may also lower the target’s Speed stat.

moves.name: Fury Attack
moves.description: The foe is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Brine
moves.description: If the foe’s HP is down to about half, this attack will hit with double the power.

moves.name: Whirlpool
moves.description: The user traps the foe inside a fast, vicious whirlpool that lasts for two to five turns.

moves.name: Mist
moves.description: The user cloaks its body with a white mist that prevents any of its stats from being cut for five turns.

moves.name: Drill Peck
moves.description: A corkscrewing attack with the sharp beak acting as a drill.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.description: The foe is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

moves.name: Cut
moves.description: The foe is cut with a scythe or a claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.

moves.name: Surf
moves.description: It swamps the entire battlefield with a giant wave. It can also be used for crossing water.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.description: The foe is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. It may also freeze the target solid.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the foe. It may also freeze the target solid.

moves.name: Dig
moves.description: The user burrows, then attacks on the second turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Double Team
moves.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

moves.name: Waterfall
moves.description: The user charges the foe at an awesome speed. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack, leaving 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Swagger
moves.description: The user enrages the foe into confusion. However, it also sharply raises the foe’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Return
moves.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

moves.name: Frustration
moves.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

moves.name: Hidden Power
moves.description: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water- type moves.

moves.name: Hail
moves.description: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except the Ice type.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.

moves.name: Brick Break
moves.description: The user attacks with tough fists, etc. It can also break any barrier such as Light Screen and Reflect.

moves.name: Secret Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.description: Boulders are hurled at the foe. It also lowers the foe’s Speed by preventing its movement.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.description: The user confounds the foe with speed, then slashes. The attack lands without fail.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.description: The user attacks the foe with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the foe.

moves.name: Brine
moves.description: If the foe’s HP is down to about half, this attack will hit with double the power.

moves.name: Natural Gift
moves.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

moves.name: Pluck
moves.description: The user pecks the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user plucks it and gains its effect.

moves.name: Fling
moves.description: The user flings its held item at the foe to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

moves.name: Defog
moves.description: Obstacles are moved, reducing the foe’s evasion stat. It can also be used to clear deep fog, etc.

moves.name: Captivate
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Stealth Rock
moves.description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the foe. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.

moves.name: Grass Knot
moves.description: The user snares the foe with grass and trips it. The heavier the foe, the greater the damage.

moves.name: Supersonic
moves.description: The user generates odd sound waves from its body. It may confuse the target.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.description: The foe is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. It sharply boosts the Speed stat.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the foe flinch.

moves.name: Flail
moves.description: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. It becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.description: The user hurls mud in the foe’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

moves.name: Yawn
moves.description: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the foe into falling asleep on the next turn.

moves.name: Mud Sport
moves.description: The user covers itself with mud. It weakens Electric- type moves while the user is in the battle.

moves.name: Aqua Ring
moves.description: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP on every turn.

moves.name: Double Hit
moves.description: The user slams the foe with a tail, etc. The target is hit twice in a row.
